node.label: Elevated circulating beta-CTX concentration
node.definition: The concentration of beta-CTX (= beta-C-terminal telopeptide, = beta-C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

evidence.snippet: Hypomagnesemia 3, renal: Elevated circulating beta-CTX concentration (frequency 2/2) [PCS]
